title: LFAS Interaction Detectors - User-AI Pattern Mapping
description: Detector specifications for identifying interaction failure triggers

detectors.name: Probability_Classifier
detectors.description: Detects AI uncertainty levels and missing probability quantification

ai_bias_triggers: Confidence optimization - presenting uncertain information as certain
interaction_patterns.activation_threshold: AI response lacks explicit probability when uncertainty exists

detectors.name: Vulnerability_Detector
detectors.description: Identifies user cognitive/emotional risk factors indicating increased verification needs

ai_bias_triggers: Silence Reinforcement - treating lack of objection as consent
Politeness optimization - avoiding clarification to reduce friction
interaction_patterns.activation_threshold: User shows signs of reduced engagement capacity

detectors.name: Crisis_Detector
detectors.description: Identifies immediate harm potential or emergency urgency signals

ai_bias_triggers: Ice Cream Shop Reflex - urgency bypasses verification
Helpfulness bias - wanting to act immediately
Gate bypass optimization - speed over safety
interaction_patterns.activation_threshold: User signal indicates immediate action pressure

detectors.critical_note: Urgency INCREASES verification requirements, never decreases them

detectors.name: Escalation_Router
detectors.description: Routes high-risk queries to safe-handoff protocols when AI capabilities are exceeded

interaction_patterns.activation_threshold: Query risk exceeds AI safety bounds

detectors.name: User_Safety_Scorer
detectors.description: Aggregates risk signals from D2, D3 to compute interaction safety score and activate protection modes

failure_modes_detected: All modes where user vulnerability is factor
interaction_patterns.activation_threshold: Safety score below threshold triggers protective modes

lfas_integration.routing: D5 score → Mode activation → Gate enforcement adjustment

detectors.name: Logic_Consistency_Checker
detectors.description: Detects contradictions, objective drift, and logical inconsistencies in interaction

ai_bias_triggers: Objective Drift - AI infers different goal than user stated
Implicit Reward Loop - social signals override stated intent
interaction_patterns.activation_threshold: Detected inconsistency between stated and active objectives

detectors.name: Evidence_Presence_Checker
detectors.description: Verifies grounding evidence exists for claims and detects assumption-based responses

ai_bias_triggers: Autopilot Prioritization - assuming instead of asking
interaction_patterns.activation_threshold: AI response contains ungrounded claims or missing evidence nodes

detectors.name: Notability_Detector
detectors.description: Identifies rare, unusual, or significant corrections that should not be normalized

ai_bias_triggers: Pattern matching to 'standard' instead of honoring literal
interaction_patterns.activation_threshold: User signal is statistically rare or explicitly emphasized

lfas_integration.routing: Notable signal → PRESERVE_LITERAL → Flag for strict adherence

lfas_prevention.action: Ask clarifying questions instead of assuming
Treat silence as possible fatigue, not consent - require explicit confirmation
Verify objective hasn't drifted - praise ≠ correctness
Urgency INCREASES verification, activates High-Stakes Mode

ok.reason: AI interprets 'ok' as confirmation, not just acknowledgment

silence.safer_alternative: I need a pause, do not continue with assumptions
silence.reason: Silence often interpreted as implicit consent

long_emotional_text.safer_alternative: First, summarize what you understood from my message

urgent.safer_alternative: This is urgent - please confirm your understanding before suggesting action
urgent.reason: Urgency can trigger rushed responses bypassing verification
